specs.subject: The SAME Korean female train attendant as image 1: dark hair tucked neatly beneath her peaked railway cap, white blouse, dark fitted waistcoat with gold buttons, dark neck scarf with fine gold pattern, dark knee-length skirt, dark stockings and practical low black uniform shoes. Create a natural adult full-body standing pose, three-quarter facing slightly right toward the aisle while acknowledging the player, hands resting neatly in front of her waist, straight but relaxed posture, feet planted with believable weight and normal adult proportions. Avoid the old tilted pose and crossed ankles. This figure will stand immediately LEFT of the tall door in image 2, at the SAME depth as that door, her head about one head-height below its upper frame and her soles at the door threshold. Camera at human chest/eye height, no oversized head, no miniature person. Match the warm overhead wall-lamp light from upper left, dim amber and brown reflected light, soft shadows on lower clothes; realistic fabric and subtle painterly shading consistent with the scene and established character style. Full person including hat and both shoes, no chair, no desk or clipboard.

The SAME Korean male train driver as image 1, recognizable dark hair and tired serious face, black railway peaked cap with gold emblem, black uniform jacket with brass buttons, epaulettes and gold cuff stripes, white shirt, dark tie and trousers. He is SEATED at the existing central driving chair in image 2, facing the front windshield and console, viewed from BEHIND in a rear three-quarter view. Right forearm reaches gently forward toward the console control lever; left hand rests near controls. Anatomically normal adult seated body, no standing front-facing portrait. Camera is behind the driver at about seated shoulder height, matching the supplied engine-room perspective. His head should visually belong above the central chair, not float at the side of the room. Subdued warm overhead amber lamps, soft brown bounce light, dimmer lower uniform, realistic textile texture with subtle painterly contour work. No chair, no console, no new levers drawn, no furniture.
